provisional_claims.summary: Ecology engine regressions: season() was offset by one (day 0 reported Highsummer, not Dawn) and phase used a 47-day cycle instead of 48. Moisture exchange read neighbors' already-updated current-day moisture instead of previous-day values, which breaks "whole garden growing together". Bare ground no longer recovered 1 nutrient/day. Plant comfort used base shade instead of effective (structure) shade. Glowcaps got the Hush penalty even though they stay suited to Hush. The severe-strain nutrient return was computed from pre-day values. The 75-day glowcap lifespan was dropped. Restored the documented behavior in engine.py.
